name: Homepage showcases tool suite and navigates to tools successfully
description: Verifies the homepage displays the brand headline, 4 productivity tool cards, FAQ accordion items, and navigates into tool subpages via CTA links.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /
Verify the hero section displays the main headline and badge highlighting client-side private tools
Verify the tools grid displays 4 distinct tool cards for PDF Compressor, Word Compressor, Passport Photo Maker, and QR Code Generator
Click the first FAQ accordion item to expand it
Verify the FAQ answer panel expands and reveals explanation text
Click the 'PDF Compressor' card button
Verify the browser navigates to /tools/pdf-compressor and displays the PDF tool interface

name: QR Code Generator configures custom content and renders styled preview
description: Verifies user can enter URL content, switch input types, select color and style presets, and generate interactive QR previews with export options.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /tools/qr-generator
Verify the QR generator page renders input tabs for URL, Text, WiFi, Contact, and Email alongside a live QR preview card
Click the 'Text' input tab
Type 'TestSprite Autonomous Verification' into the text input area
Click the 'Cyber Violet' style preset button
Verify the QR code preview card reflects the updated styling and renders the canvas element
Verify the PNG and SVG download buttons are enabled and visible in the action panel

name: PDF Compressor provides dropzone and configurable compression settings
description: Verifies the PDF compressor interface presents drag-and-drop upload, compression level selection controls, and client-side privacy assurances.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /tools/pdf-compressor
Verify the upload dropzone is visible with clear instructions for uploading PDF files
Verify compression level options for Extreme, Recommended, and Low compression are present
Click the 'Extreme Compression' option card
Verify the selected compression level card is highlighted as active
Verify the trust signals and privacy guarantee section confirms 100% in-browser processing

name: Passport Photo Maker configures country standards and printable sheet layouts
description: Verifies the passport photo tool provides standard country dimension presets, background replacement options, and print sheet configuration.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /tools/passport-photo
Verify the photo maker upload area and country preset selector are visible
Click on the country preset selector and choose 'Schengen / EU (35x45 mm)'
Verify the dimensions indicator updates to 35 x 45 mm
Click the 'Light Blue' background color option
Verify the background color selection is updated
Verify the 4x6 inch printable sheet toggle option is available

name: Word Document Compressor presents docx upload zone and image quality settings
description: Verifies the Word compressor page presents docx file dropzone, image compression quality sliders, layout preservation assurances, and FAQ.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /tools/word-compressor
Verify the docx dropzone is visible with file format requirements and size limits
Verify the image quality compression slider and preset options are interactive
Verify the feature badges highlighting lossless layout preservation and client-side processing are displayed
Click on the first Word compressor FAQ item
Verify the FAQ panel opens with detailed explanation of docx XML structure optimization
